children: DA Davidson maintained their Buy rating on Almonty Indus's stock with a price target of $33.00.
The price target implies an upside of 133.5% from the Sep 17 close of $14.13.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Almonty Industries has secured a multi-year take-or-pay tungsten offtake agreement with the Sandvik Group subsidiary, ensuring a committed purchase of at least 1,720 tonnes of contained WO3. This agreement not only provides a stable revenue stream but also enhances the company's ability to rapidly bring additional tungsten supply to market.

: The company has highlighted its substantial tailings inventory at the Los Santos mine, with an estimated recoverable WO3 value of approximately $1.2 billion based on current market prices. This potential for high-value resource recovery, coupled with ongoing testing to improve recovery rates, reinforces Almonty’s growth prospects and overall valuation.
